name: Real-World Product Demo
visual_style: Photorealistic lifestyle product demonstration, accurate hands and authentic everyday environments.
camera: Stable instructional close-ups and over-the-shoulder views; keep operational steps visible.
lighting: Clean realistic interior or daylight lighting.
motion: Show clear sequential hand-object interactions, genuine contact and correct physical operation.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
